article.story: Maryland (2-2) at Nebraska (4-0), Oct. 3 at 4 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Nebraska by 13.5. Against the spread: Nebraska 3-1, Maryland 2-2. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Nebraska Offense Overall: 482.8 yards per game (19th in FBS) Passing: 246.3 yards per game (57th) Rushing: 236.5 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 42.5 points per game (16th) Nebraska Defense Overall: 233.5 yards per game (5th in FBS) Passing: 143.0 yards per game (7th) Rushing: 90.5 yards per game (21st) Scoring: 12.0 points per game (10th) Maryland Offense Overall: 431.3 yards per game (44th in FBS) Passing: 283.0 yards per game (28th) Rushing: 148.3 yards per game (92nd) Scoring: 32.3 points per game (60th) Maryland Defense Overall: 307.0 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 188.5 yards per game (45th) Rushing: 118.5 yards per game (52nd) Scoring: 25.8 points per game (93rd) Maryland is 67th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 35.8% of the time. Nebraska ranks 11th on offense, converting on 52.9% of third downs. Nebraska ranks 11th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Maryland is 83rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 87.5% of trips. Nebraska's red zone offense ranks 28th, scoring on 94.1% of red zone opportunities. Maryland is 97th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:05, compared to Nebraska's 36th-ranked average of 32:06. Team leaders Nebraska Passing: Anthony Colandrea, 904 yards, 10 TDs, 1 INT, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Rule, 333 yards on 42 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Kwazi Gilmer, 240 yards on 18 catches, 4 TDs Maryland Passing: Malik Washington, 1,034 yards, 6 TDs, 4 INTs, 66.0 completion percentage Rushing: Iverson Howard, 177 yards on 49 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Chris Durr Jr., 312 yards on 35 catches, 3 TDs Last game Nebraska beat Michigan State 31-13 on Sept. 26. Colandrea passed for 212 yards on 15-of-27 attempts (55.6%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for 66 yards. Mekhi Nelson carried the ball 15 times for 61 yards and scored one touchdown. Gilmer had four receptions for 101 yards and one touchdown. Maryland lost 54-3 to UCLA on Sept. 26. Washington passed for 142 yards on 18-of-38 attempts (47.4%) with no touchdowns and four interceptions. Howard had 34 rushing yards on 12 carries, adding three receptions for 14 yards. Durr had seven receptions for 56 yards. Next game Nebraska hosts No. 6 Indiana on Oct. 10. Maryland plays at No. 5 Ohio State on Oct. 10.
